name: select-menu
title: Select Menu
description: A vertical option list: a highlight glides down to an option as the pointer follows it, presses it and commits it with a check, then fades back.
useWhen: A game or app menu needs a highlight sliding between options, then committing one.
A settings list shows a tactile press and selection check.
avoidWhen: A dropdown that opens from a trigger: use select or dropdown-menu.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Selected index
variables.description: Which option the highlight glides to and commits (0 is the first).

variables.label: Variant
variables.description: Soft outlined highlight or solid primary highlight.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
